+def parse_host_authority(host_header: str, *, require_valid_port: bool) -> tuple[str, str | None] | None:
+    """Parse a Host header into its host and optional decimal port."""
+    if host_header.startswith("["):
+        closing_bracket = host_header.find("]")
+        if closing_bracket == -1:
+            return None
+
+        literal = host_header[1:closing_bracket]
+        try:
+            if "%" in literal:
+                raise ValueError
+            ipaddress.IPv6Address(literal)
+        except ValueError:
+            if _IPV_FUTURE_RE.fullmatch(literal) is None:
+                return None
+
+        host = host_header[: closing_bracket + 1]
+        remainder = host_header[closing_bracket + 1 :]
+        if remainder == "":
+            return host, None
+        if not remainder.startswith(":"):
+            return None
+        port = remainder[1:]
+    else:
+        if "[" in host_header or "]" in host_header:
+            return None
+
+        host, separator, port = host_header.rpartition(":")
+        if separator == "":
+            host = port
+            port = None
+        elif ":" in host:
+            return None
+
+        if _REG_NAME_RE.fullmatch(host) is None:
+            return None
+
+    if port is not None:
+        if _PORT_RE.fullmatch(port) is None:
+            return None
+        if require_valid_port:
+            significant_digits = port.lstrip("0") or "0"
+            if len(significant_digits) > 5 or int(significant_digits) > 65535:
+                return None
+
+    return host, port
+
